build_windows_app: build a COLMAP Windows application bundle by copying executables, DLLs, and batch scripts into an app directory
run_build_windows_app: run the script with --install_path and --app_path arguments to assemble a COLMAP Windows deployment package
create_zip_archive: create a zip archive of the COLMAP Windows app directory for deployment using shutil.make_archive
copy_dlls_and_exes: copy all .exe and .dll files from the install directory into the app bin and lib folders
mkdir_if_not_exists: create a directory if it does not already exist, asserting the parent directory exists
